name: NOM: Noise of Mist - Shader (not compatible with ShadowZ)
description: Optional. Replaces the game's screen shader with its own: chromatic aberration, grain and distortion in the fog. Requires NOM: Noise of Mist. Do not use with ShadowZ or any other mod that changes screen.frag. The game compiles the shader once per session, on the first world loaded: after turning it on or off, restart the game.
